trial_court: District Judge, Sankardev Nagar, Hojai (Title Suit No.56/2021)
facts_of_case: Petitioner married respondent in 2013 and had a child in 2014. Matrimonial disputes arose, and petitioner left her husband's home in 2017. Petitioner now seeks to transfer the divorce suit filed by her husband to Guwahati.

legal_principles.principle: A party seeking transfer of a case has to demonstrate sufficient reasons for the same.
legal_principles.held: The burden lies on the petitioner to demonstrate that it would be difficult for her to contest the proceeding effectively if the case is not transferred.

legal_principles.principle: A party's convenience is not a sufficient reason to transfer a case.
legal_principles.held: The respondent/husband contended that he has to look after his business as well as other family members and it would be difficult for him if the case is transferred to Guwahati. However, this Court does not find any compelling reasons to transfer the case in favour of the respondent.

outcome.final_order: The court allows the petition for transferring the title suit (divorce) from Hojai to Guwahati.
